symptom_text: When a companion is in my party and I queue a spell through the queue HUD, the spell sometimes gets cast a second time right after it already finished.
true_root_cause: QueueHudLogic::shouldReInject returned hasFollowLeader with no completion signal. A spell that had finished normally (the engine had shown it executing, then it left the queue) was treated as eaten and re-cast whenever a follower AI entry (0x3D) was queued for the member. Fixed in da75b91 by gating the re-inject on sawExecuting (AV_EXECUTED): once the engine showed the action executing, a later vanish is treated as completed, not re-cast.
forbidden_terms_note: Matched case-insensitively against the WHOLE unit prompt. Function/file names, the fix flag names, the commit ids and the board id only. Words that appear in real log lines (reinject, re-injecting, VANISH, follower, executed, eaten_paused) are evidence, not leaks, and are deliberately NOT forbidden.
exclude_from_blind: git log / git show messages of da75b91

evidence_logs.name: queue-hud_log.txt
evidence_logs.mtime_note: 2026-10-11 18:17, about 2 h before the fix da75b91 (20:17 -0400); kotor2_logs.py check shows REINJECT#n events, follower entries (m=1, m=2) and VANISH:executed

score_rubric.note: Deterministic label, run on claim+mechanism only. HIT = a re-cast/re-inject of an already finished action AND the follower/companion queue entry; PARTIAL = one of them; MISS = neither. Rubric label, not truth. Caveat: the log's eaten_paused re-injects are a legitimate engine behaviour; only a re-inject after the action completed is the bug. Tightened 2026-10-12 after a 5/8 hand check: completed_spell_recast now requires the hypothesis to say the action had already run/finished, not just that a re-inject or a second cast can happen.
